_notes: raster_deg: road direction of BOTH materials in the layer plane (0 = parallel to the mean interface, 90 = perpendicular). material_model 'isotropic' reproduces the v1 model. da.extend: paths run to the next corner (max max_ext) for the propagation / stability analysis. lateral: 'periodic' = interior cell of a periodic array (no free edges, left/right edges tied with equations incl. free macroscopic dofs); 'free' = single-feature specimen with free sides.

crack_contact._notes: frictionless contact on the crack faces for curved interfaces (sine, U) in shear. FROZEN: no further model changes; remaining overlaps (e.g. long U-arc cracks in tension) are flagged in post-processing.
